insights.title: Portfolio tracks 87 materials across two data sources
insights.text: The tracked universe now covers 87 raw materials — 62 sourced from Fastmarkets (exchange-assessed physical pricing) and 24 from NBR customs import data, plus 1 from Volza — averaging +10.5% week-on-week.

insights.title: FEED ADDITIVE leads, WHEAT BRAN trails WoW
insights.text: FEED ADDITIVE posted the sharpest weekly gain at +330.4%, while WHEAT BRAN fell -40.0% WoW.

insights.title: LIMESTONE POWDER cheapest, L-METHIONINE most expensive
insights.text: LIMESTONE POWDER is the lowest-priced tracked material at ~$62/MT, while L-METHIONINE is the most expensive at ~$4,950/MT.

insights.title: 9 materials confirmed high-cost, 63 flagged for review
insights.text: 9 materials carry a confirmed High Cost signal versus alternative sourcing (MAIZE/CORN, CORN FOB, SOYMEAL CIF, SOYMEAL CIF Hi-Pro, ANIMAL FEED, DICALCIUM PHOSPHATE (DCP)…), while 63 additional materials are flagged for supplier review.

insights.title: Source demarcation: Fastmarkets 62 · NBR Data 24
insights.text: Fastmarkets provides transparent exchange-assessed physical quotes (62 materials — grains, oilseeds, meals, vegetable oils), while NBR customs data covers 24 additives, amino acids, minerals and feed supplements at actual Bangladesh landed-import values.
